room_description: An Egyptian tomb filled with hieroglyphics. It features a central sarcophagus, statues of Anubis and Horus guarding the sides, sun motifs, and glowing floor panels.

key_moments.description: Establishing shot of the Egyptian tomb.
Collecting the top piece of a golden pyramid from the floor.
Entering a hidden chamber behind the Sphinx statue.
Solving the element wheel puzzle to open the wall compartment.
Retrieving a golden scarab beetle from the compartment.
Solving the large sliding tile mural puzzle.
Using the scarab beetle to unlock the glowing sun emblem.
Collecting the bottom half of the golden pyramid.
Placing the assembled pyramid onto the altar.
Taking the golden eye token and unlocking the exit.

solution_steps: Interact with the circular panel on the wall showing elemental symbols.
Rotate the rings to align the symbols according to the environmental clues (Fire on bottom, Water on right, Sun on left, Moon on top).
Interact with the large chaotic mural on the wall.
Slide the rectangular segments horizontally and vertically to form a coherent picture of Egyptian figures and deities.
puzzles.reward: Access to the sun emblem lock

solution_steps: After finishing the mural, a sun emblem is revealed.
Place the golden scarab beetle into the center indentation of the sun emblem.
puzzles.reward: Access to the inner sanctum / Pyramid base

solution_steps: Retrieve the base of the pyramid from the inner sanctum.
Combine the top (found on the floor earlier) with the base.
Place the completed pyramid onto the square pedestal in the main room.

final_action: The player places the assembled golden pyramid on the pedestal, which reveals a compartment containing a Golden Eye token. This token is inserted into the main door mechanism to unlock it.
